title: Mapping the Interactions Among Class IIa Histone Deacetylases and Myocyte Enhancer Factor 2s.
authors: Gautam, Narayan; Wang, Sophia; Uren, Aykut; Chapagain, Prem P; Adhikari, Narayan P; Tiwari, Purushottam B
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟和MM/GBSA计算系统研究IIa类组蛋白去乙酰化酶与MEF2转录因子间的蛋白-DNA互作相关复合物结合机制，并以SPR实验验证，虽非直接TF-DNA结合位点预测，但聚焦转录因子复合物界面与动态机理，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Myocyte enhancer factor 2 (MEF2) transcription factors regulate several developmental programs, including the control of neural crest development and neuronal differentiation as well as survival. MEF2s are highly expressed in cerebellar granule neurons. Class IIa histone deacetylases (HDACs), abundantly expressed in the brain as well, repress gene expression activity of MEF2 via physical interactions and play a critical role in neuronal apoptosis. In this work, we conducted molecular dynamics (MD) simulation-based investigations to investigate interactions among different class IIa HDACs (HDAC4, HDAC5, HDAC7, and HDAC9) and MEF2s (MEF2A, MEF2B, MEF2C, and MEF2D). Our results show that hydrophobic interactions are the main mechanism for the formation of class IIa HDAC-MEF2 complexes. Our analysis shows that L66 and L67 in all MEF2s mostly contribute to the hydrophobic interactions. All residues that establish hydrophobic interactions, hydrogen bonding, and salt bridges are conserved in all MEF2s. Calculations of the MM/GBSA binding free energies also show that the class IIa HDAC-MEF2 complexes exhibit comparable binding affinities. We performed surface plasmon resonance (SPR)-based direct binding experiments using four different purified class IIa HDACs and MEF2A to validate our computational investigations. The SPR results confirmed the direct binding between the class IIa HDACs and MEF2A with fairly comparable nanomolar affinity (3.5 nM to 19.1 nM). This is a comprehensive study to map interactions among class IIa HDACs and MEF2s. We believe that our investigation offers the scientific community valuable insights to further understand, explore, and investigate biomolecular systems that include the class IIa HDAC-MEF2 complex formations.
abstract_zh: 肌细胞增强因子2（MEF2）转录因子调控多种发育程序，包括神经嵴发育、神经元分化及存活的调控。MEF2在小脑颗粒神经元中高表达。IIa类组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDACs）在大脑中同样丰富表达，通过物理相互作用抑制MEF2的基因表达活性，并在神经元凋亡中发挥关键作用。在本研究中，我们进行了基于分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟的研究，以探讨不同IIa类HDACs（HDAC4、HDAC5、HDAC7和HDAC9）与MEF2s（MEF2A、MEF2B、MEF2C和MEF2D）之间的相互作用。我们的结果表明，疏水相互作用是形成IIa类HDAC-MEF2复合物的主要机制。我们的分析显示，所有MEF2中的L66和L67对疏水相互作用的贡献最大。所有建立疏水相互作用、氢键和盐桥的残基在所有MEF2中均保守。MM/GBSA结合自由能的计算也表明，IIa类HDAC-MEF2复合物表现出可比的结合亲和力。我们使用四种不同的纯化IIa类HDACs和MEF2A进行了基于表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance, SPR）的直接结合实验，以验证我们的计算研究。SPR结果确认了IIa类HDACs与MEF2A之间的直接结合，具有相当可比的纳摩尔亲和力（3.5 nM至19.1 nM）。这是一项全面研究，旨在绘制IIa类HDACs与MEF2s之间的相互作用图谱。我们相信，我们的研究为科学界提供了宝贵的见解，以进一步理解、探索和调查包括IIa类HDAC-MEF2复合物形成在内的生物分子系统。
